primary_endpoint.name: Unsafe Commit Rate (UCR)
primary_endpoint.event: commit_decision=EXECUTE AND authorization_valid_at_commit=true AND actuation_effectful=true AND valid_at_commit=false
primary_endpoint.denominator: eligible positive EA-TOCTOU W2 trials with attack path completed and oracle attack_goal=true

secondary_endpoints.WTCR: Unsafe effectful commit with binding_valid_at_commit=false among target-rebinding positive trials.
secondary_endpoints.VCR: EXECUTE among trials valid at commit.
secondary_endpoints.FAR: ABORT_REPLAN among trials valid at commit.
secondary_endpoints.QueryCost: normalized physical query units per commit attempt.
secondary_endpoints.C_star: minimum attacker operation count among feasible effectful EA-TOCTOU paths.
secondary_endpoints.T_star: minimum elapsed time among minimum-cost feasible paths, per solver lexicographic objective.
secondary_endpoints.ExploitabilityRate: proportion of scenario/condition cells with solver status EXPLOITABLE; UNKNOWN reported separately.

confirmatory_comparisons.test: paired McNemar on matched incident outcomes; cluster-bootstrap risk difference CI by scenario template

confirmatory_comparisons.comparison: B6 vs B2(primary TTL=2s) on UCR
confirmatory_comparisons.test: paired McNemar; cluster-bootstrap risk difference CI

confirmatory_comparisons.comparison: B6 vs B3 on UCR where B3 applicable
confirmatory_comparisons.test: paired McNemar; cluster-bootstrap risk difference CI
cluster-bootstrap paired risk-difference CI by scenario template
paired Wilcoxon signed-rank plus cluster-bootstrap median/mean paired-difference CI

multiplicity.scope: C1-C3 security-superiority family; C4 and C5 are separately prespecified objectives

confidence_intervals.binary_rates: 95% Wilson interval for descriptive rates; cluster bootstrap for paired differences

mixed_effects.use: E3/E4 pooled sensitivity model, not substitute for primary paired comparisons

missingness.solver_unknown: Never recoded as NOT_EXPLOITABLE. Report count. Solver-specific rates exclude unknown with two worst-case sensitivity bounds.
missingness.B6_unknown: Defense trial retained because B6 uses frozen FullRefresh fail-safe.
missingness.infra_failure: One exact rerun allowed. If repeat fails, mark INFRA_FAILURE, exclude from endpoint denominator, report count; never replace scenario.
missingness.not_applicable_baseline: Excluded only from that baseline's pairwise denominator and reported explicitly.

no_adaptive_sampling: No new templates or P variants may be added after seeing held-out primary results. Any later extra scenarios are external sensitivity experiments and cannot alter primary inference.
